Interface PaletteDragSupport.DragImageProvider

Enclosing class:
PaletteDragSupport
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface PaletteDragSupport.DragImageProvider
Optionally supplies a BufferedImage to display under the cursor during a drag.

Only called when DragSource.isDragImageSupported() returns true. Returning null falls back to the default system drag cursor with no custom image.
